header.sub: Irreversible actions on your account. Each action requires your password.

pause.sub: You will no longer receive missions. Reactivate at any time from this menu.
pause.confirm: Your account will be paused. You can reactivate it at any time.

desactiver.sub: Account deactivated for 30 days. After that, manual reactivation will be required.
desactiver.confirm: Your account will be deactivated for 30 days.

supprimer.sub: Irreversible action. All your data, missions, and history will be deleted.
supprimer.confirm: ⚠️ WARNING: this action is IRREVERSIBLE. All your data will be deleted.
